items.t: Barclays Maintains Equal-Weight on Baidu, Lowers Price Target to $72
items.sum: Barclays analyst Jiong Shao maintains Baidu (NASDAQ:BIDU) with a Equal-Weight and lowers the price target from $80 to $72.

items.t: Susquehanna Maintains Neutral on Baidu, Lowers Price Target to $75
items.sum: Susquehanna analyst Shyam Patil maintains Baidu (NASDAQ:BIDU) with a Neutral and lowers the price target from $105 to $75.

items.t: Baidu (BIDU) AI Linked Revenue Reached 53% Of General Business Revenue
items.sum: Baidu (NasdaqGS:BIDU) reported Q3 2026 results, with AI linked revenue now accounting for over half of General Business revenue. AI Cloud Infrastructure revenue for the quarter rose 94%, while GPU Cloud revenue increased 191% in Q3 2026. items.t: Baidu shares hit record low as Q3 earnings, AI concerns weigh
items.sum: Investing.com-- Baidu's (HK:9888) Hong Kong-listed shares fell to a record low on Wednesday, as investors continued to digest disappointing quarterly results and growing concerns over its ability to translate AI investments into sustainable growth.

items.t: Baidu Q3 2026: Between A Skinnier Cash Cow And An Expensive AI Bet
items.sum: Baidu (BIDU) stock is a sell, as a slight EPS beat does not change the weak advertising outlook or uncertain returns on AI investment.
